### The Fear of Men
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fear-men
Passage: Jeremiah 38:19
Points:
- King Zedekiah demonstrates the disastrous consequences of fearing other people rather than revering God.
- Though he recognized Jeremiah as God's true prophet and had him lifted from the cistern, Zedekiah still wavered under peer pressure.
- Jeremiah urged the king to surrender to Babylon to preserve his life and save Jerusalem from burning.
- Zedekiah refused to obey because he dreaded being mistreated by fellow Judeans who had already deserted.
- The fear of human opinion paralyzes obedience, whereas cultivating the fear of the Lord enables faithful service.
